pattern.description: After the feedback dialog closes, the screen-recorded cursor drifts down through the idea table and out below it; row and cell hover highlights flick on and off as it passes, leaving the table at rest.
pattern.why_premium: Weak premium signal: this is incidental cursor travel in a raw screen recording. The only craft is that the cursor clears the table so the final frame is clean for the sign-off line.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to(cursor, {y: '+=200', duration: 0.23, ease: 'power2.out'}); row hover: tl.set(row, {backgroundColor: '#f4f5f7'}) at enter and tl.set(row, {backgroundColor: 'transparent'}) at leave, keyed to the cursor's y position.
build_hint.remotion: Cursor y = interpolate(frame, [0, 7], [y0, y1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); row/cell hover background is a boolean from the cursor's y against row bounds (no tween).

notes: Motion energy is tiny (changed_share 0.0013 for b01); the change is hover-state flicker plus cursor travel. Cursor end position needed a manual box.
